touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Colwyn Bay qualifies as a local detour through Welsh Mountain Zoo and Bryn Cadno. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Colwyn Bay: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
